answer: Proof-of-Engagement Seals** reward only identities that accumulate verified interaction over time; a new identity starts at zero and cannot skip ahead. Each seal requires a minimum span of uninterrupted activity, so a farm of fresh identities must pay the sonnet of sustained compute-hours across every account in parallel. That parallel cost scales linearly with identity count, unlike the reward. A glacier of dormant accounts cannot shortcut the span rule, and any attempt to burst activity leaves a crystal gap in the timing record that disqualifies the seal.
